Strong analytical, debugging, communication, and problem-solving skills. Ability to mentor junior QA engineers, conduct automation code reviews, and influence quality practices across teams. Documentation and best practices: Maintain test documentation, automation guidelines, reusable templates, framework standards, and coding best practices. AI-assisted quality engineering: Use AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Playwright AI-assisted locators, and test generators to accelerate automation creation, refactoring, documentation, and productivity. Continuous improvement: Drive improvements in automation coverage, test reliability, execution efficiency, sprint quality metrics, and release confidence. Team leadership: Mentor junior QA engineers, support automation code reviews, promote knowledge sharing, and influence quality-first engineering behaviors. Work shift: Work in overlapping time zones with US teams as required to support collaboration and delivery continuity.
